Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.

Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Selesnya Sanctuary's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{W}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.

When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.

When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.

When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

413-4640-8032--201.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Swordsman ability, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

You control another creature or artifact.
You control your commander.

Activate Taii by paying at least {1} and tapping it.
Activate your commander using the ability granted to it by Street Urchin by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing at least 2 damage to Smaug due to Taii Wakeen.
Smaug triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.

2448-5220-6900-7492.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2448-5220-6900-7492.description:
Cast Goblin Firestarter by paying its mana cost.
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2713-3094-4659-5434-7344.description:

Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

3227-4872-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scrivener
When the Scrivener token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-5256-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5256-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5256-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

1987-2239-7089.description:

Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking the two targeted permanents.
Resolve the original Ghostly Flicker, blinking the targeted permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

997-4681-5170-6634.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1322-1453-2387-3490.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.

Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

Repeat.

Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage

The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Shilgengar abilities.

Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.

Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer

Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.

Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Ley Druid any number of times.

Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kydele.

1636-3685-4497-5202.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding seven {R} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.

Efficient Construction triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
The Thopter enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Repeat.

Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

618-2187-4377.description:

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Possessed Skaab with haste.
The token copy of Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1110-2281-5237.description:
Cast Saffi by paying {G}{W}.
Saffi enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks, targeting Renegade Rallier.
Holding priority, activate Saffi by sacrificing it, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield the next time it dies this turn.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Saffi's power to Renegade Rallier.
Renegade Rallier dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Renegade Rallier enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Terror of the Peaks.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Renegade Rallier's power to any target.
Resolve the Renegade Rallier trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
